prompt: Write a self-contained Blender 5.2 Python script that builds a 3D sculpture corresponding to the drawing. Match the visible parts, their arrangement and overall form. The geometry may be stylised. Use an overall height of approximately 100 Blender units. Z is up; the front of the sculpture faces negative Y. Create geometry only: no cameras, lights, rendering, file reads or writes, external assets, add-ons, shell commands or network access. You may import only bpy, math and mathutils. Clear the starting scene and build the sculpture. Overlapping solid meshes are acceptable for this visual study; watertightness will not be scored. Additional constraint: the cable's free end must end in a distinct plug seated in a socket on the front face of that same power strip, perpendicular to the socket face. The occupied socket can be hidden by the plug; retain two other visible empty sockets above it. The plug must mate with the strip, rather than enter the head beside it. Return the script, a short description, and uncertainties as the requested JSON object.
